title: Learning trombone by piano rolls and from Willie Fawcett
summary: Robinson learned by playing along with a piano and piano rolls, then learned fast from Willie Fawcett in the army band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone
